text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: PD-INC-8342 — SEV: P1 — GPU memory pressure on pool infer-prod-eu-west-2-2. Trigger: cuda_alloc_fail_rate > 5% (1m). Affected model(s): gpt-small-v2-quant. Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/gpu-memory-pressure

pagerduty-bot: page assigned to @carla_oncall (30s)

carla_oncall: ack @pagerduty-bot — looking now

carla_oncall: checking pool metrics and recent deploys

ben_platform: pinging from infra, any config changes? I see a deploy ~5m ago to route 'chat/v1' — could be a seq-len spike

carla_oncall: logs show repeated "cudaErrorMemoryAllocation" in /var/log/runtime/gpu1.log. sample:

```
E 1751234567.123 kernel.cu: cudaErrorMemoryAllocation: out of memory when allocating 4194304 bytes
stack: runtime/allocator.cpp:124
```

carla_oncall: running `redwoodctl pool list infer-prod-eu-west-2-2` -> 96% utilization, 12/12 GPUs at ~11.9Gi free (nominal)

alice_m: customer-facing — is this impacting live traffic? Any customer errors showing?

dave_support: Support reports spike in 5xxs for `email-summarize-prod` and `search-service` starting 1751234550. Error rate peaked ~4.8% (SLO is 1%).

carla_oncall: mitigation plan (quick): 1) temporarily scale pool (add node) 2) route heavy seq-len traffic to fallback low-mem variant 3) lower batching for chat/v1

ben_platform: I'll trigger scale-up and enable auto-shedder to reduce batch sizes

ben_platform: cloud command: `cloudctl instances add --pool infer-prod-eu-west-2-2 --type p4d-small --count 1` — API accepted, starting instance infer-prod-eu-west-2-2-node-13 (ETA ~90s)

carla_oncall: applying route override to move some traffic to fallback pool:

```
redwoodctl route update chat/v1 --pool infer-fallback-eu --max_batch_size=2 --force
```

carla_oncall: route updated, traffic shifted ~30% in last 20s

incident-bot: alert update: cuda_alloc_fail_rate dropping to 1.1% (1m) after route update

dave_support: customer error rate for search-service decreased to 1.2% — trending downward

alice_m: notifying affected customers: initial incident note posted to #support-incidents and sent to SLA contacts

ben_platform: new node joined pool, utilization down to ~75% across pool

carla_oncall: running quick heap/kv checks. There's evidence of kv-cache evictions coincident with the spike (shard 17). sample logs:

```
kubectl logs pod/infer-789 | grep -i cuda
... cudaErrorMemoryAllocation ...
... eviction triggered for kv-cache shard 17
```

carla_oncall: evictions observed but they settled once routing and scale-up applied

carla_oncall: short summary for handoff: PD-INC-8342 — symptoms: transient cuda allocation failures across pool; likely cause: sudden sequence-length + batch spike after recent deploy to chat/v1 leading to higher simultaneous token allocations. Mitigations applied: route override to fallback pool, temporary scale-up (+1 node), lowered max_batch_size for chat/v1. Customer impact: elevated 5xxs for two services, peak ~4.8%, currently <1.5%. Next steps: infra to run post-deploy load test, add conservative per-route max_batch_size/rate-limits, investigate kv-cache fragmentation. Owner for follow-up: @ben_platform (infra); postmortem owner: eng-runtime.

alice_m: +1 — I'll lead customer comms and coordinate the postmortem notes

carla_oncall: handing off to @ben_platform for follow-up; I'll be available for 30m if anything pops back up

ben_platform: taking handoff. I'll check ML runtime mem patterns, quantify delta from pre-deploy baseline, and propose a config guard for future deploys. Will post updates in #eng-runtime.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD-INC-8342 condition cleared — alert resolved at 1751234735

carla_oncall: closing thread — created follow-up ticket INT-889 for postmortem and action items (assigning to ben_platform). :white_check_mark:
